name: Twinadew Window: Inertia
source:
Two guys are stuck in an elevator with each other.

This was already an inconvenience, but it's made worse by the fact that all attempts to contact the outside have failed.

...The elevator also hasn't stopped moving downward somehow, even though, by this point, they've been there for at least a day. No building is so large that an elevator could run for that long, right? They'd have to stop at some point?

[From [url=https://pengosolvent.itch.io/tw-inertia]itch.io[/url]]
